title: The Night Report of Pataliputra
logline: On a monsoon night, a young cart driver must carry a ferry clerk's urgent report across timber-walled Pataliputra, dodging night patrols, before the river floods the moat.

objectives.text: Reach the Ganga ferry wharf and take the sealed report from the ferry clerk.
Pass the timber yard and the palisade lane without being stopped by the night watch.
Deliver the report to Overseer Kshema at the moat sluice house.

dialogue.speaker: Sudatta
dialogue.text: Rain on the river means trouble in the city. Keep the cart low and quiet, Ila.

dialogue.speaker: Ila
dialogue.text: Three stops. The wharf, the timber lane, the sluice house. I will be fast.

dialogue.speaker: Vasuka
dialogue.text: Take this to the overseer. Do not read it here, and do not stop for anyone.

dialogue.speaker: Ila
dialogue.text: A secret at night. Fine. The timber lane is next.

dialogue.speaker: Vasuka
dialogue.text: Hear the watch drums? They are searching the lanes tonight. Hold steady.

dialogue.speaker: Ila
dialogue.text: Past the palisade posts. The sluice house is near.

dialogue.speaker: Overseer Kshema
dialogue.text: A jammed sluice, not a plot. Thank you. Wake the timber crews at once.

dialogue.speaker: Ila
dialogue.text: That was the secret? Water. I was ready for worse.

dialogue.speaker: Vasuka
dialogue.text: A lantern swept us. Back into the shadow of the posts!

dialogue.speaker: Ila
dialogue.text: Wheel hit a post. Steady now, nothing broken.

dialogue.speaker: Sudatta
dialogue.text: They stopped the cart. Come back to the yard and try another lane.

dialogue.speaker: Vasuka
dialogue.text: The watch changes at the drum. Wait for it, and we go again.

dialogue.speaker: Overseer Kshema
dialogue.text: The crews have reached the weak stretch. The wall will stand tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Ila
dialogue.text: No glory in it. Just a wall that held and a city still asleep.
